en.headline: Police arrest Porsche driver in Tsim Sha Tsui after finding cannabis in car
en.dek: Officers stopped the vehicle on Bristol Avenue on Sunday night, found a small amount of suspected cannabis and arrested the man on suspicion of drug driving.
body: Police arrested a man on Sunday night after stopping his Porsche in Tsim Sha Tsui and finding a small quantity of suspected cannabis inside the vehicle.

West Kowloon traffic officers intercepted the car on Bristol Avenue at about 10.02pm after noticing suspicious behaviour. Officers located the suspected cannabis and summoned a sniffer dog to assist further searches.
The driver, who police said failed a rapid oral fluid test, was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence of drugs. The case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀保時捷車內檢獲懷疑大麻 男司機涉藥駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方周日晚上約10時在碧仙桃道截查車輛，發現少量懷疑大麻，司機未能通過口腔液測試，涉嫌毒後駕駛被捕。
body: 警方周日晚上在尖沙咀截查一輛保時捷私家車，在車內發現少量懷疑大麻，男司機涉嫌藥後駕駛被捕。
西九龍交通部人員約晚上10時02分在碧仙桃道截停該車，指車輛形跡可疑。人員其後在車內檢獲懷疑大麻，並召緝毒犬到場協助進一步搜查。
警方表示，司機未能通過快速口腔液測試，涉嫌「毒後駕駛」被捕。案件仍在調查中。
